component.name: DevTunes
component.summary: A premium, developer-focused music client built with Electron

description.p: DevTunes is a gorgeous, premium music client designed specifically for developers. It streams high-quality audio directly and provides a seamless developer-friendly interface, rich animations, and background playback optimization.

ul.li: High-quality ad-free music streaming from YouTube Music
Local proxy audio server with yt-dlp integration
Sleek frameless design with custom window controls
